status: Frozen before this sensitivity computation, after review of the original benchmark
study_stage: Post hoc robustness checks requested during manuscript review; not prospective preregistration or independent confirmation
purpose: Resolve model averaging, changing evaluation subsets, penalty dependence and prior-work differentiation without new architecture search
calibration: Reuse original sorted-patient random permutations and nested prefixes for every predictor and method. No additional allocations.

evaluation_designs.common: Within each repeat, every budget uses order[max_budget:] as its evaluation subset. SCAN-B n=455; METABRIC n=1778; GSE42568 n=54. This subset is fixed across budgets within a repeat, not across repeats. Unused calibration-pool patients at a smaller budget are not reassigned to evaluation.

penalty_definition: Summed IPCW cloglog negative log likelihood plus kappa*a^2/2; penalize the intercept only, slope fixed at 1
fit_sources: Reuse all archived coefficients for existing methods. Refit kappa=5 to verify exact reproducibility, but use the archived kappa=5 coefficients for evaluation. Fit kappa=2.5 and 10 only on the calibration patients.
censoring: Calibration weights estimated on that budget's calibration patients; evaluation weights re-estimated on each actual evaluation subset. Same established tied-time convention and zero-event handling. No evaluation outcomes enter fitting.
primary_reporting: Preserve original primary analysis. Report both evaluation designs, all three predictors, all budgets and all three fixed penalties. Do not select a new preferred penalty from these results.
comparisons: ordinary minus unchanged by predictor and budget
summaries: Monte Carlo standard error conditional on the fixed cohort
interpretation_rules: Separate the equal-predictor mean from each predictor; do not infer a common patient threshold from a mean crossover.
Retain a budget crossover only in the designs and predictors in which its sign change is observed.
Call a direction stable over the checked penalty range only if it holds at all three specified strengths; record any counterexample.
A lower mean and reduced upper-tail losses are distinct from winning in most allocations.
No population significance claim, clinical utility claim or independent architecture validation follows from these post hoc checks.
stop_rule: Stop after this fixed grid and the three-paper literature comparison. If a claim fails, narrow or remove that claim; do not search additional penalties, models, seeds or cohorts to rescue it.
